title: Big River Fly Fishing
specs: Fishing on a drift boat for stealth and access to long river stretches
Target species include smallmouth bass, walleye, sauger, northern pike, gar, channel catfish, rock bass, drum, carp
11 miles of guided river pass through largely undeveloped Kankakee River State Park
Wildlife sightings include bald eagle, osprey, beaver, white-tail deer
Weather appropriate clothing, hat, polarized sunglasses recommended
Trips accommodate up to two anglers; pricing is the same for one or two anglers

blurb: Guests spend their trip on a drift boat fishing primarily for smallmouth bass on the Kankakee River, including 11 miles through largely undeveloped areas. The guide offers fly casting instruction and helps guests learn river patterns and fishing techniques. Trips accommodate up to two anglers and include shuttle service and premium fly fishing gear; lunch is provided on full day trips.
extraNote: $150 deposit required to hold reservation; deposits are non-refundable · Balance collected at end of trip · Trips can be rescheduled with at least 30 days notice · Full payment required for cancellations within 7 days · Rain check issued if operator cancels due to weather or unforeseen circumstances · March through October

quotes.text: Will possesses a deep knowledge of the Kankakee River, its geology and its history, and more importantly, a deep knowledge of where to find the smallmouth. We appreciated the fact that Will individualized his on-the-water instruction..."- Robert and Lisa, Oak Park, IL

Will is awesome. I've known and fished with him for years... when he introduced me to the Kankakee river I was amazed that such a phenomenal fishery existed so close to Chicago..."- Graham Smith, Glen Ellyn, IL
